summary: Texas Roadhouse, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its Q1 2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.75 per share. The filing contains routine operational updates and a standard dividend declaration, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program beyond ordinary dividends, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. As a result, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
